chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Kindi from Ahmad ibn Udeys from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu al-Subah who said: I heard a speech reported from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and from Ali (peace be upon him) and from Ibn Mas'ud, so I presented it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). He said: This is the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). I recognize it.

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The wretched one is the one who is wretched in the womb of his mother, and the happy one is the one who heeds the advice given to others. And the most intelligent of the intelligent is the pious one, and the most foolish of the foolish is the immoral one. And the worst of the reporters is the reporter of lies, and the worst of matters is their innovations. And the greatest of blindness is the blindness of the heart, and the worst of regrets is the regret on the Day of Judgment. And the greatest of sins in the presence of Allah is the lying tongue, and the worst of gains is the gain of usury, and the worst of consumptions is eating the wealth of the orphan. And the best of adornments is the adornment of a man: good conduct with faith, and the control of his affairs by it and the strengthening of its conclusions.

And whoever follows fame, Allah will make him known as a liar. And whoever turns his heart to the world, he will be frustrated by it. And whoever recognizes affliction, he will be patient with it, and whoever does not recognize it, he will be afflicted. And doubt is disbelief. And whoever is arrogant, Allah will humble him. And whoever obeys Satan, he disobeys Allah. And whoever disobeys Allah, Allah will punish him. And whoever is grateful, Allah will increase him. And whoever is patient with a calamity, Allah will help him. And whoever places his reliance on Allah, Allah is sufficient for him.

Do not anger Allah by pleasing anyone from His creation, and do not draw near to anyone from the creation such that you move away from Allah. For indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, there is nothing between Him and anyone from His creation that gives him good or repels evil from him except by His obedience and following His pleasure. And indeed the obedience of Allah is success from every good that is sought and salvation from every evil that is feared.

And indeed Allah, Mighty is His mention, protects whoever obeys Him, and whoever disobeys Him does not seek protection in Him. And the fugitive from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will not find an escape. And the command of Allah descends even if the creatures dislike it. And everything that is coming is near. Whatever Allah wills happens, and whatever He does not will, does not happen. So cooperate in righteousness and piety, and do not cooperate in sin and animosity. And fear Allah. Indeed Allah is Severe in punishment.

key_terms.نَدَامَةُ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ: Regret on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the wretched and the happy according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) validates this comprehensive hadith as authentic Prophetic speech, linking it to the broader tradition of the Prophet's final will to Ali (as). The text synthesizes key Shia ethical concepts, such as 'pre-eternal wretchedness' and 'prudence being piety,' while emphasizing that divine obedience is the exclusive mechanism for salvation and protection from evil.

en.hubeali: H 14487 – Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Muhammad Al-Kindy, from Ahmad Bin Udeys, from Abaan Bin Usmaan, from Abu Al-Sabbaah who said: ‘I heard a speech reported from the Prophetsaww and from Aliasws, and from Ibn Mas’oud. So I presented it to Abu Abdullahasws. Heasws said: ‘These are the words of the Messengersaww of Allahazwj. Iasws recognise them’.

The Messenger<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> said: ‘The wretched one is the one who is wretched in the womb of his mother, and a happy one is the one who heeds the advice given to the others. And the most intelligent one of the intelligent ones is the one who is pious, and the most stupid of the stupid ones is the immoral. The most evil of the report is the report of the lies (false report), and the most evil of the matters is the innovations. And the blindness of all blindness is the blindness of the heart, and the worst regret is the regret on the Day of Judgement. 
And the greatest of the sins in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the lying tongue, and the most evil of the gains is the gain of the interest. And the most evil of the consumption is the consumption of the wealth of the orphans. The best of the decors of the decors of the man is good guidance along with faith, and the controlling of his affairs by it and strengthening them.

The one who seeks fame (show-off), Allah<sup>azwj</sup> makes him to be named as a liar, and the one who loves the world will be frustrated from it. And the one who recognises the affliction would be patient against it, and the one who does not recognised it will be tortured (during it). And the doubt is disbelief, and the one who is arrogant, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Puts him in his place. And the one who obeys Satan<sup>la</sup> disobeys Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the one who disobeys Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Punished by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. The one who is thankful, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Increases for him, the one who is patient upon a loss is Helped by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. The one who places reliance upon Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> suffices for him.

Do not Enrage Allah<sup>azwj</sup> by pleasing anyone from His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and do not seek nearness to anyone from the creatures who takes you far away from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, there is nothing between Him<sup>azwj</sup> and anyone from His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures anything by which good can be acquired nor evil be repelled except by being obedient to Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and the following of His<sup>azwj</sup> Pleasure. And in the obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is success in every good that you want, and salvation from every evil which is feared.

And that Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Mighty is His<sup>azwj</sup> Mention, Defends the one who is obedient to Him<sup>azwj</sup> and the one who is disobedient to Him<sup>azwj</sup> does not seek protection from Him<sup>azwj</sup>. And the fugitive from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic will not find an escape, and that the Command of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Descend even though the creatures may be averse to it. And everything which is to come is near, and Whatsoever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires has happened and whatsoever He<sup>azwj</sup> does not Desire will not happen. So help each other towards the righteousness and the piety and do not help each other towards the sins and the animosity. And fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for He<sup>azwj</sup> is Severe is the Punishment’.
